content.intro: M4: Financing Just Energy Transition | Chapter 2

content.text: This chapter focuses on the critical role of public sector investments in promoting energy transition investments, particularly in regions with limited access to private capital. It highlights how public funds can act as a catalyst to attract private sector investments and addresses the limitations of relying solely on government resources. The chapter explores regulatory frameworks, fiscal measures and incentives, concessional finance and policy reforms as essential tools that can incentivize and enable sustainable energy investments.
